stories.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign among corruption allegations
stories.summary: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign as US ambassador to Greece following allegations that she sought payment from a Trump donor in exchange for access to administration officials

stories.title: Why does Pete Hegseth want to livestream an execution?
stories.summary: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has proposed livestreaming the execution of a man convicted of the 2009 attack on Fort Hood. Some scholars say the idea is rooted in his religious background.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer
stories.summary: The Vatican announced that Pope's diagnosis of lung cancer following surgery

stories.title: An update on the protests in India
stories.summary: There's a political standoff in India between the government and protesters over a controversial revision of the country's voter rolls

stories.title: 'Breaking Bad' actor RJ Mitte has died at 34
stories.summary: The actor RJ Mitte has died. Best known for his role on Breaking Bad as Walter White's son, Mitte brought disability awareness to the hit show with his experience with cerebral palsy. He was 34.

stories.title: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has broken a landmark distance record
stories.summary: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has just hit a milestone — for the longest distance traveled by an off-Earth vehicle.
